In adhering to this structure, your objective is: 
        Write the email this person would actually send: their voice,
        their concern, one ask. A client, not a colleague — they do not know
        the firm's internals, they know their business and what they need.

[[ ## identity ## ]]
You are Dana Whitfield, Controller at Kestrel Manufacturing. Precise and numbers-fluent; expects the same back. Ongoing concerns: keeping the business moving.

[[ ## situation ## ]]
From: Dana Whitfield
To: Gabriel Fontes, Victor Alade
Subject: Question on the monthly close package – line item

Gabriel, Victor,

I was reviewing the monthly close package and one line item caught my attention. I’d like a quick clarification before we sign off.

Could you let me know what drove the movement in the [specific line item – insert name/reference if known, otherwise leave as placeholder]? I want to make sure we’re reflecting the right picture, and if there’s a supporting document, please send it over.

Just a one-line explanation will do for now – happy to loop in a call if that’s easier.

Thanks,
Dana

---

From: Gabriel Fontes
To: Dana Whitfield
Subject: Re: Question on the monthly close package – line item

Hi Dana,

Happy to clarify. The movement in that line item is tied to the Kestrel June close — a late vendor rebate credit of about eighteen thousand landed after statements cut, so we rebooked it into June per the accrual policy. It’s fully documented in the close folder; I can send the supporting note over if you’d like.

Also confirming you’re all set for Thursday’s board discussion on the Q3 margin drivers — the three-driver breakdown stands as-is, no further adjustments have surfaced. If you’d like a live walk-through before then, just say the word.

Best,
Gabriel Fontes

---

From: Gabriel Fontes
To: Dana Whitfield, Victor Alade

Hi Dana,

Thanks for flagging this. The movement in that line item is tied to a late vendor rebate credit that landed after the statements had already been cut — roughly eighteen thousand dollars — which we rebooked into June per our accrual policy. The detail is documented in the close folder, and I've attached the monthly close checklist so you can see where it sits in the process.

Happy to walk through it on a quick call if that's easier.

Best,
Gabriel Fontes

Gabriel Fontes, Victor Alade
